facts.heading: Highest-risk customers (risk ≥ 50)
facts.content: LumenPartners B (CUST-0009) and MapleSolutions (CUST-0018) are the two most at risk, both at risk=70. Next tier: OnyxCollective A (CUST-0012) at 57.5, then VertexPath A (CUST-0001), LumenDynamics C (CUST-0003), and CrestPartners (CUST-0029) all at 55. OrbitAnalytics B (CUST-0013) is at 50 and LumenDynamics (CUST-0094) at 52.5.

facts.heading: Why they are at risk
facts.content: The top two (LumenPartners B, MapleSolutions) have already canceled, show severe engagement collapse (sessions −62% and −75% vs prior 4 weeks), and have open plus urgent tickets, indicating unresolved problems. LumenDynamics C and CrestPartners also combined cancellation with −75% session declines; VertexPath A canceled with −74% sessions. OnyxCollective A is the most alarming still-active case: −37% sessions, 7 urgent tickets, and low satisfaction (<3). OrbitAnalytics B combines −39% sessions, 4 urgent tickets, and low satisfaction.

facts.heading: Scope of exposure
facts.content: 29 customers are flagged at-risk representing $53,387 of revenue at risk (plus 2 customers with unknown revenue).

interpretation.heading: Pattern in the drivers
interpretation.content: Two dominant signals recur: (1) churn status (canceled or paused) and (2) a steep engagement drop of roughly −37% to −75% in sessions over the last 4 weeks. On top of these, dense urgent-ticket backlogs and low satisfaction (<3) mark customers where the problem is ongoing and unresolved rather than a one-off.

recommendation.heading: Prioritized actions
recommendation.content:
1) Rescue the two risk=70 accounts — LumenPartners B (CUST-0009) and MapleSolutions (CUST-0018): both already canceled with severe session drops and unresolved urgent tickets; attempt immediate win-back with a named CSM and resolution of open tickets before churn finalizes.
2) Defend the still-active high-value risk, OnyxCollective A (CUST-0012, risk 57.5): 7 urgent tickets + low satisfaction while active — treat as highest-priority save since there is a live path to recovery.
3) For canceled risk=55 accounts (CUST-0001, CUST-0003, CUST-0029): confirm whether churn is final; if not, execute win-back given steep engagement loss.
4) Address the shared root cause across the top tier: resolve urgent-ticket backlogs and restore engagement for any customer with sessions down >50%.
5) Watch LumenDynamics (CUST-0094, paused) and OrbitAnalytics B (CUST-0013) — at risk but still recoverable with intervention.

other_sections.heading: Uncertainty
other_sections.content: Several at-risk accounts (e.g. VertexPath A CUST-0001, LumenDynamics C CUST-0003) are already marked canceled, so 'risk' partly reflects lost revenue rather than preventable churn; win-back likelihood is unverified. Revenue is unknown (NULL) for two accounts (e.g. CUST-0013, CUST-0014), so exposure there may be understated. Satisfaction and resolution data are absent for unresolved tickets.
